reason: Alacritty has no graphics protocol and no background image, so it shows no picture

Windows Terminal shows a picture only as a profile’s backgroundImage, and a pane cannot change its profile, while the settings reload that changes one puts every pane back on its scheme’s colors, so ttheme gives it no picture
Warp paints a tab only through the settings.toml init wires, so ttheme use in a Warp init never wired asks to wire it first, and the wiring puts on the palette’s picture with its colors
Konsole opens an OSC 8 link only where the profile allows escaped links, off by default, and ttheme writes colors only, so preview marks the post as a link only where the user’s profile allows them
Terminal.app opens no OSC 8 link and draws no kitty graphics, so preview marks no post with the ⧉ of a link and offers no find, whose results are pictures
Terminal.app reads a profile once, at launch, so a palette tuned since then is painted over its base profile with OSC colors, which carry no picture, until Terminal.app restarts
